notes.note: Edited: claimIntegrationOAuthIssuerPin and .station-oauth-issuer. Checked against config-loader-storage.ts and tool-server-oauth.ts. Other inputs: the module map adds the per-resource OAuth issuer pin (.station-oauth-issuer) for integrations without a declared issuer; storage adds read/claim functions for .station-oauth-issuer and refuses plugin bundles carrying it; station-runtime.ts only validates STATION_OAUTH_CLIENT_METADATA_URL at construction (a malformed value refuses startup); mcp-manager.ts passes the Station home to the OAuth client config so providers read the issuer pin; mcp-service.ts passes the home to the OAuth client config, records an explicit scope choice for remembering, and returns rememberedScopes in account status.
